title: Keep support draft recovery local and omit task output_schema
answers: Why does the support draft call omit output_schema?
Why does draft polling report no agent message?
Where should support-specific draft recovery live?
body:
Convention: products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_async uses MultiTurnSession.start_raw without output_schema and validates the returned text locally.
Mechanism: The PR description explains that schema-backed output storage completes the task run before an agent message reaches the log, causing polling to fail with no agent message.
Layering: Keep support-specific nudging and fallback handling in products/conversations/backend/temporal/ai_reply/activities/draft.py:_draft_from_session and _give_up so other shared-runner callers retain their behavior.
Constraints: This exception applies to the support draft task; the five one-shot model calls retain their JSON schemas.
applies: Support draft task invocation and placement of its response recovery logic.
